tr: Proje, Culfa ilçesinde 27.000 m2'lik bir alanda yer almaktadır. Proje tek parselden oluşmakta olup, projenin üretim kapasitesi 1 megavattır. Projede 1 trafo merkezi, 36 m2 tek katlı kontrol binası yapılmıştır.

Projeye 5 adet 10.000 watt'lık rüzgar türbini sonradan eklenmiştir. Alan 720 metre tel pano ile çevrilmiş, 700 metre enerji hattı kazılmış, 2080 panel desteği betonlanmış, 80 panel desteği takılmış, 3520 panel yerleştirilmiştir.
en: The project is located on a 27,000 m² site in the Julfa district. It consists of a single parcel, and its production capacity is 1 megawatt. A transformer station and a 36 m² single-storey control building were built within the project.

Five 10,000-watt wind turbines were later added to the project. The site was enclosed with 720 metres of wire fencing, 700 metres of power line were trenched, 2,080 panel supports were concreted, 80 panel supports were installed and 3,520 panels were placed.
